Subject: Project Timeline Update: New Delivery Date

Dear [Client Name],

I'm writing to update you on the timeline for your project. The third-party integration required for this phase has taken longer to certify than the vendor originally projected, which has pushed the schedule back by two weeks. Our team has been in close contact with the vendor throughout this process to keep the delay as short as possible.

Based on the revised certification timeline, we now expect to deliver the completed project on 14 April. All other aspects of the build remain on track, and our team will continue working through the remaining milestones in parallel wherever possible to make the most of the additional time.

Does the new date of 14 April work with your internal plans, or are there any downstream deadlines on your end we should factor in? Please let us know, and we'll be happy to walk through the updated schedule in more detail on a call if that would help.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
